# Work Dashboard

*No workstreams yet. This file is generated: create one and it will fill in:*

```bash
atlas work new <slug> --owner person:you
atlas work sync
```

Every initiative in this repository gets exactly one numbered workstream here,
with a fixed skeleton of nine numbered sections (plan, tasks, requirements,
decisions, research, deliverables, validation, agents, issues). Markdown is canonical;
this dashboard and `index.yaml` are derived.

Rules: `spec/workstream.md` in the atlas repository.
